name: local-au111
source: User instruction in the current benchmark/skill conversation, 2026-11-01: at most five or six pulses per session (hard cap six); review strategy after two consecutive pulses without improvement; new conditioning protocol requires SafeTip Off. Review may consider another voltage or TipShaper but authorizes no automatic action.
counter_scope: pulse_attempts counts Bias.Pulse only; budget.actions_attempted counts all conditioning attempts including separately audited TipShaper. Changing strategy or reviewing does not reset either cumulative counter. The no-improvement streak counts pulses only; a separately evidenced improvement updates action and pulse boundaries without resetting cumulative pulse count.
